summary: This TrueCost report processes three bidders for the operation and maintenance of 200 electric buses on a Gross Cost Contract in Bhubaneswar. All three bidders—GreenMetro, MetroLink, and UrbanDrive—have achieved an 'ok' status and are ready for evaluation. Each bidder incorporates the national WPI Electricity sub-index as a proxy for the state electricity tariff in their escalation formulas. One open question remains regarding a discrepancy between numerical and written figures in GreenMetro's financial proposal. Resolving this specific currency question will clarify GreenMetro's exact quoted rate.
